title: Jamaican Chickpea Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Jamaican-inspired chickpea curry dish. Serve over rice or with naan bread.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add diced jazzy and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add chickpea, curry powder, and curry. Stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over rice or with naan bread.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
Cooking time can be reduced by using pre-cooked chickpea or curry powder.
Adjust spice level to taste by adding more or less curry powder.
